Travel: Desperately need a holiday — eyeing Greece in the spring. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Michael Nelson

P.S. Have you watched any good shows lately?

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at MongoDB.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 10, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 16, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 26, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 31, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 28, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 09, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, MongoDB offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $37 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Ava Evans
Head of People & Culture | MongoDB
+1-402-450-8880

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 08, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 23, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 13, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 08, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Jackson Hall

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at SAP.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 15, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 04, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 11, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 11, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 11, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 07, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, SAP offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $94 for gym/wellness expenses

Subject: HR Notice: Updated Remote Work Policy
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at ServiceNow.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 16, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 19, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 10, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 24, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 12, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 05, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, ServiceNow offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $95 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
James Garcia
Head of People & Culture | ServiceNow
+1-328-832-6494

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at HashiCorp.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 05, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 14, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 11, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 30, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 11, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 11, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, HashiCorp offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $34 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Harper Jackson

+1-961-408-8536

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at MongoDB.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 11, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 05, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 24, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 23, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 04, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 09, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Add or remove dependants

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Hey Linda,

I hope this email finds you well! I know we've both been terrible at keeping in touch lately but I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out properly rather than just sending a message that gets buried.

So — how are you? What's new? Fill me in!

On my end, things have been a whirlwind. Here's a brief update:

Work: Started something new that I am genuinely excited about. The commute is rough but everything else is good

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Desperately need a holiday — eyeing Italy in the spring. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for a walk sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Omar Moore

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Noah Rivera

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Subject: HR Notice: Updated Remote Work Policy
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at IBM.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 06, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 15, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 19, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 28, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 05, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 05, 2026 to May 18, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, IBM offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $75 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Joseph Brown
Head of People & Culture | IBM
+1-909-843-7349

────────────────────────────────────────────

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Lenovo.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 05, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 11, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 25, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 22, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 06, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 18, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Lenovo offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $61 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
John Adams

+1-463-487-9463

Subject: Are you free this week?
Body:
Hey Thomas,

I hope this email finds you well! I know we've both been terrible at keeping in touch lately but I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out properly rather than just sending a message that gets buried.

So — how are you? What's new? Fill me in!

On my end, things have been a whirlwind. Here's a brief update:

Work: Considering a career change — more on that soon. The commute is rough but everything else is good

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Desperately need a holiday — eyeing Mexico next month. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for dinner sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Sarah Campbell

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

Subject: Benefits Update: New Health Insurance Options Available
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at McKinsey.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 07, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 18, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 30, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of June 04, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 29, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 05, 2026 to May 07, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, McKinsey offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $74 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Isabella Torres
Head of People & Culture | McKinsey
+1-809-249-3661

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Shopify.

1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 10, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 12, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 16, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 28, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 11, 2026

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 05, 2026 to May 16, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Shopify offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $79 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Barbara Wilson

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 07, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 16, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 19, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 18, 2026

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 10, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $61 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Thomas Johnson

Michael Baker

David Sanchez

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Workday.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 07, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 22, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 04, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 20, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 11, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Workday offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $58 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Logan Evans
Head of People & Culture | Workday
+1-337-479-8778

• Add or remove dependants

Warm regards,
John Torres

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Accenture.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 11, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 08, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 22, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 23, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 11, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 07, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Accenture offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $98 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Michael Scott
Head of People & Culture | Accenture
+1-877-887-7602

Subject: Team Announcement: Welcoming Ahmed Sanchez to the team
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at GitHub.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 05, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 09, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 16, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 23, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 31, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 07, 2026 to May 18, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, GitHub offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $47 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Benjamin White
Head of People & Culture | GitHub
+1-951-653-8963

Body:
Hey Elijah,

Work: Things have been really busy but rewarding. Really enjoying the new role

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Desperately need a holiday — eyeing Portugal next month. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Robert Green

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants

Subject: Reminder: Annual Performance Review Cycle Begins May 12, 2026
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Datadog.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 10, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 22, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 25, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of June 03, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 08, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 05, 2026 to May 11, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Datadog offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $53 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Mary Wright
Head of People & Culture | Datadog
+1-740-489-6995

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Databricks.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 04, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 08, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 18, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 18, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 07, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 07, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Databricks offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $65 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Once the transfer is confirmed, I will personally brief you on the full details. Please treat this with the highest level of confidentiality.

Time is absolutely critical. Please respond within the next 30 minutes.

Best regards,
Samuel Johnson
Managing Director
Snowflake

• Add or remove dependants

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at McKinsey.

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 08, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 21, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 11, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, McKinsey offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $67 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Abigail Jackson

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Michael Harris

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

Take care,
Noah Green

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Elastic.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 11, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 05, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 26, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 08, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 09, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 07, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Elastic offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $39 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Charlotte White
Head of People & Culture | Elastic
+1-243-911-4769

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $86 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Fatima Phillips

+1-897-540-9045

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Datadog.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 13, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 09, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 10, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 31, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 25, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Datadog offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $33 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Samuel Taylor
Head of People & Culture | Datadog
+1-525-548-6733

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 17, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 10, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 12, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

Evelyn Roberts

• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Warm regards,
Mary Gomez

• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Warm regards,
Noah Hernandez

The annual performance review cycle will open on May 11, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 10, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 26, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Patricia Smith
